title: Next.js HTTP request deserialization can lead to DoS when using insecure React Server Components
reason: Next.js 14.2.15 RSC DoS advisory. Unexploitable in CareerMonke due to static export (output: 'export'); no live Node.js React Server Component runtime in production. Scheduled for Next.js 15.5+ upgrade prior to public launch.

title: Next.js has a Denial of Service with Server Components
reason: Next.js Server Components DoS. Unexploitable in CareerMonke because the application is built with static export; server components are compiled at build time, not rendered dynamically by a Node server.

title: Next.js Vulnerable to Denial of Service with Server Components
reason: Next.js Server Components DoS. Unexploitable due to static export compilation; dynamic requests are handled by serverless Netlify Functions, not Next.js Node server.

title: Next.js vulnerable to server-side request forgery in applications using WebSocket upgrades
reason: Next.js SSRF in WebSocket upgrades. CareerMonke static export does not implement or expose Next.js WebSocket upgrade endpoints.

title: Next.js has a Middleware / Proxy bypass in Pages Router applications using i18n
reason: Next.js Pages Router i18n middleware bypass. CareerMonke uses App Router with static export and does not use Pages Router i18n.

title: Next.js: Denial of Service in App Router using Server Actions
reason: Next.js Server Actions DoS. CareerMonke does not use Next.js Server Actions; dynamic backend functionality is hosted on Netlify Functions.

title: Next.js: Server-Side Request Forgery in Server Actions on custom servers
reason: Next.js SSRF in Server Actions on custom servers. CareerMonke does not deploy a custom Node.js server or use Server Actions.

title: Next.js: Server-Side Request Forgery in rewrites via attacker-controlled destination hostname
reason: Next.js rewrite SSRF. Rewrites are statically declared in netlify.toml without user-controlled dynamic destination hostnames.

title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution on windows-hosted servers
reason: Next.js Windows server RCE. CareerMonke production deployments run on Netlify (Linux serverless / static CDN), not Windows server hosting.

title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used
reason: Next.js Image Optimization API AVIF RCE. CareerMonke relies on static assets and Netlify Image CDN rather than the vulnerable Next.js dynamic image optimizer server.

title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when SVG files are used
reason: Next.js Image Optimization API SVG RCE. CareerMonke is statically exported; self-hosted Next.js image optimization API is disabled and unreachable.

title: Next.js: Denial of Service in App Router using Server Actions
reason: Next.js Server Actions DoS in App Router. Server Actions are not implemented or enabled in the codebase.

title: PostCSS: Arbitrary file read and information disclosure via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS comments
reason: PostCSS build-time arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL. PostCSS is a build-time dependency bundled with Next.js; no user-supplied CSS comments are processed in production.

title: PostCSS: Path Traversal in Previous Source Map Auto-Loading (sourceMappingURL) leads to Arbitrary .map File Disclosure
reason: PostCSS build-time path traversal in sourceMappingURL. Used exclusively during build compilation and not exposed to external runtime user input.
